items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I had saved this other issue from ten years ago from another jazz magazine, and I pulled it out and it was Nat Hentoff...

ctx.x: I’m reminded that, getting back to jazz now, recently I received a DownBeat and the title in bold letters was jazz — sorry, “Race Matters.” And I said, wow, and I went over to my bookshelf, because I had saved this other issue from ten years ago from another jazz magazine, and I pulled it out and it was Nat Hentoff and the title was “Race Matters.” And so I guess my obvious question was does race matter?
